Fact: eval_datasets
What to find: Datasets or benchmarks used for evaluation.
Card sections that often contain it: Evaluation, Benchmarks

Answer with status, value, quotes and section.

answer.value: Instruct model evaluated on AIME 2025, GSM-Plus, LiveCodeBench v4, GPQA Diamond, IFEval, MixEval Hard, BFCL, and Global MMLU. Base model evaluated on HellaSwag, ARC-CF, Winogrande, CommonsenseQA, MMLU-CF, MMLU Pro CF/MCF, PIQA, OpenBookQA, BoolQ, HumanEval+, MBPP+, MATH, GSM8k, and Ruler 32k/64k/128k. Multilingual benchmarks include MLMM Hellaswag, Belebele, Global MMLU (CF), and Flores-200. Evaluations use lighteval.
quotes: In this section, we report the evaluation results of SmolLM3 model. All evaluations are zero-shot unless stated otherwise, and we use [lighteval](https://github.com/huggingface/lighteval) to run them.
